articles.original_title: Google alternative Kagi launches an email service
articles.title_pt: Google alternative Kagi launches an email service
articles.excerpt: Kagi, which already offers a paid alternative to Google Search and its own Orion browser as a rival to Chrome, is taking on another Google service: Gmail. Today, Kagi announced a public beta of Kagi Mail, a new email service that has "no surveillance, no ads, open standards, and no lock-in." With Kagi Mail, you […]
articles.summary: A Kagi lancou um servico de e-mail em beta publico chamado Kagi Mail. A nova ferramenta promete zero anuncios e nenhuma vigilancia, competindo diretamente com o Gmail.
